einzeiler: The surprising history of how a humble Naples street food became a global phenomenon.
kurzfassung: Pizza originated as a cheap street food for working-class people in 18th-century Naples. Italian immigrants brought the dish to the United States in the early 1900s, where ingredients like tomato sauce and mozzarella were adapted. The rise of car culture and widespread delivery eventually propelled pizza into a massive worldwide success.
stichpunkte: Pizza started in the 1700s in Naples, Italy, as a cheap, yeasty flatbread for busy workers.
Inventors like Samuel Morse initially dismissed pizza in 1831 as a disgusting, sewer-like creation.
Italian immigrants brought pizza to New York City in the early 1900s, opening the first pizzerias in America.
American pizza adapted by using canned tomato sauce, stringier local mozzarella, and hotter coal-fired ovens.
Delivery services in the 1960s, pioneered by chains like Domino's, helped pizza spread across suburban America.
Tom Monaghan of Domino's boosted efficiency by inventing stackable pizza boxes and conveyor-belt ovens.
The world's oldest operating amusement park, Bakken in Denmark, opened in 1583 after people gathered around a natural spring.

clips.text: Samuel Morse traveled to Naples in 1831 and expressed extreme disgust for local pizza, comparing it unfavorably to waste from a sewer.
Because fresh Italian ingredients could not be easily imported, American pizzerias substituted fresh tomatoes with canned sauce and used stretchier local mozzarella cheese.
After arriving with immigrants, pizza evolved through new toppings and styles, remaining popular primarily in cities and among specific communities for decades.
Domino's founder Tom Monaghan redesigned operations by inventing stackable, thick cardboard boxes and utilizing conveyor belt ovens to speed up production.

clips.hook: The surprising age of amusement parks
clips.text: The oldest running amusement park began in Denmark during the year 1583 after crowds flocked to a newly discovered natural spring for clean water.

beschreibung:
Pizza is a food loved around the world. It started as a local dish served by street vendors in Naples, Italy. Not everyone loved it right away. But over time, pizza changed, and the world fell in love. Join Joy and co-host Zsa Zsa as they learn the fascinating history of this fantastic food. Plus we hear your slogans for pizza and play First Things First.
